raw_segments.text: Portia, Tari, Jew, the law hath yet another hold on you. It is enacted in the laws of
Venice if it be proved against an alien that by direct or indirect attempts he seek the
life of any citizen. The party, against the which he doth contrive, shall seize one half
his goods. The other half comes to the privy coffer of the state, and the offender's life
lies in the mercy of the duke only, against all other voice.
In which predicament I say thou standst thee, for it appears by manifest preceding that
indirectly, and directly too, thou hast contrived against the very life of the defendant, and thou
hast incurred the danger formerly by me rehearsed. Down therefore, and beg mercy of the duke.
